announcements.headline: Vast Admitted to DIBC & Cornerstone Consortium
announcements.insight: Admission to DIBC & Cornerstone Consortium follows August re-admission. This suggests a formal sale process or strategic review is underway for Vast Resources.

announcements.headline: Repayment of Debt
announcements.insight: Repayment of debt follows the August RTO and Glencore finance agreement. This reduces leverage but offers limited immediate shareholder value.

announcements.headline: Further Subscription & Issue of Fee Shares
announcements.insight: Further subscription follows the August re-admission to AIM. Shareholders should monitor dilution from this capital raising.

announcements.headline: Readmission - Vast Resources Plc
announcements.insight: Vast Resources Plc completes its RTO and re-admits to AIM trading following the August retail offer and general meeting results.

announcements.headline: Completion of RTO & Re-Admission to Trading on AIM
announcements.insight: Completion of the RTO follows the August retail offer and general meeting results. Re-admission to AIM trading restores liquidity for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Results of General Meeting
announcements.insight: Shareholders should monitor the outcome of the general meeting following the August retail offer and debt facility updates.

announcements.headline: Glencore Finance Agreement
announcements.insight: Following the July debt facility, this agreement supports the ongoing acquisition process. Shareholders should monitor progress toward the court sanction stage.

announcements.headline: Oversubscribed Retail Offer & Total Voting Rights
announcements.insight: The oversubscribed retail offer follows the July debt facility and August schedule update, indicating progress in the proposed acquisition process.

announcements.headline: Schedule One - Vast Resources PLC
announcements.insight: Following the June acquisition update and July debt facility, this filing likely advances the proposed transaction. Shareholders should monitor for further progress on the deal completion.

announcements.headline: US$10M Debt Facility and Transaction Update
announcements.insight: Vast Resources secured a US$10M debt facility following its June update on a proposed acquisition. This funding supports the ongoing transaction process for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Update on Proposed Acquisition
announcements.insight: Vast Resources provides an update on a proposed acquisition. Shareholders should monitor for further details regarding the transaction's progress and terms.
